Ana (AE): Heads-up - ValenCare wants ISO 27001 scope pages, SOC2 bridge letter, and a signed "pen-test confirmation" before they release the PO. They also asked whether we can provide a dedicated staging tenant for a 72h external scan.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): We can provision an isolated tenant in our staging cluster. Need customer scan IPs and expected throughput. If they ramp to sustained qps we might need a short reservation.
Sofia (InfoSec): ISO scope pages and SOC2 bridge are fine to share redacted. Pen-test confirmation: we have a standard attestation but Legal must approve the signer name. Also want the probing rules (no fuzzing at kernel level).
Ana (AE): They mentioned they require the attestation to include proof of vulnerability remediation for high-risk items in the last 12 months. Can we provide that?
Sofia (InfoSec): We can provide a remediation summary table: date discovered, mitigation summary, and ticket ref. No export of raw internal tickets. That's our usual approach.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Quick question: do they want presigned test datasets hosted in our bucket? We should avoid sharing prod snapshots. Recommend this workflow: generate synthetic dataset or give them a presigned object with tight expiry and IP restrictions.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): ```bash
# presign example for devs
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-temp/valencare-test-data.zip --expires-in 1800
# set bucket policy to only allow GET from their scan IPs
```
Ana (AE): Procurement is holding pricing pending confirmation of the staging window and a signed attestation. If we have to carve out a dedicated pool, that'll change the quote.
Sofia (InfoSec): Also flag: if they request BYO scanner that performs authenticated tests, we need to rotate service account keys and audit access. We can provide a short-lived service principal (1-2 day TTL) and log exports.
Nate (Legal): I'll review the attestation signer and NDA language. If customer wants the CISO name specifically we'll need exec approval. Also recommend an SOW for the scan describing scope and liabilities.
ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-3142: "ValenCare evidence & staging-scan coordination" assigned to Sofia (InfoSec). Priority: high.
Sofia (InfoSec): I'll attach the SOC2 cover page + ISO scope excerpt and draft attestation. Nate, please review signer field and liability clause.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): For pricing note: estimate +15% on Dedicated quote for the reserved burst and monitoring during a 72h external scan, plus optional on-call support. Will post numbers tomorrow.
Ana (AE): Action list: Sofia -> send artifacts & draft attestation; Nate -> review signer & SOW language; Ravi -> confirm staging runbook + cost delta; I'll push timeline with ValenCare.
Ana (AE): ValenCare asked for the scan window next Thu-Fri. Can we commit?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Tentative yes but need ops confirmation for capacity. I'll ping infra and lock time after cost approved.
Sofia (InfoSec): Also require that the tester provide insurance cert and a short scope sheet with allowed vectors. We'll include that in the attestation.
Ana (AE): Great. I'll update the buyer and ask for tester name and certs. Thanks team :handshake:
